item.title: Moby-Dick
item.description:
A whaling voyage becomes an investigation of obsession, memory and the limits of human knowledge. Ishmael joins the crew of the Pequod, unaware that its captain is chasing something far more dangerous than a whale.

This is sample content for the theme demo. Replace it with your own description, a note about why the club chose the book, or a longer post-meeting write-up.

item.title: Pride and Prejudice
item.description:
Elizabeth Bennet and Mr Darcy begin with the worst possible impression of one another. What follows is a comedy of manners, money and the slow correction of first judgements.

This is sample content for the theme demo. Replace it with your own description or reading notes.

item.title: Frankenstein
item.description:
Victor Frankenstein creates life, then abandons it. Shelley’s novel follows the consequences of that refusal of responsibility, told through letters, confessions and a creature who learns to speak for himself.
